notes: Strings may be written as {"repeat":s,"count":n}; loaders expand to s repeated n times before use.
receiver_rejects: receive-side validator (graph validate_changes / SyncGraph.validateChanges) must return an error.

receiver_accepts_skips: validator accepts; projection (project_links / applySynced) reports `projection` = applied | applied_metadata_only | skipped | gone | not_applicable; skip_count is the number counted.

writer_refuses: writer self-check input is `input.row` plus optional `input.context`; expect.outcome = emitted | row_refused | cell_skipped; expect.cells maps a suffix to its exact value (null = null cell); expect.absent lists suffixes that must not be emitted.
enable_ops: expect.kernel is checked against the existing kernel today; expect.receiver against the link receiver (pending).
